entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Nov 2, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: City Manager Briefings on Budget, External Agencies, Planning, and Parking. The City Manager scheduled four 15-minute briefings covering the September monthly budget report, external agency updates, planning, building and development, and parking fee compendium and ordinance changes from the parking study.

entry.title: Council & government · Fri, Jul 24, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: City Council Strategic Workshop on Governance and Leadership. City Council scheduled a strategic workshop with discussion topics including "Leadership as Stewardship," "Building Trust That Strengthens Governance," "Leading Through Healthy Conflict," "Leadership In Action," a "City Manager Presentation," and "Leadership Legacy: Moving Forward."
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6532,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Jul 20, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Amended Intergovernmental Agreement for Roanoke Valley Greenway. The City Council adopted an ordinance approving an Amended and Restated Intergovernmental Agreement regarding the Roanoke Valley Greenway. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: Public Hearing on the 2027 Legislative Agenda. The Legislative Committee held a public hearing led by Vice-Mayor McGuire to receive public comments on the City of Roanoke's 2027 Legislative agenda. No action was taken.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6524,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Jul 6, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Employee Cannabis Policy Inquiry. Council Member Nash asked about regulations regarding cannabis use by employees and updating City policies. The City Manager indicated the City was looking into an update.
Adopted: Electronic Participation Policy for Council Meetings. Council adopted a resolution establishing a written policy for participating in City Council meetings through electronic communication. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Reenactment of the Code of the City of Roanoke. Council adopted an ordinance to readopt and reenact the Code of the City of Roanoke (1979), as amended. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6513,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Jun 15, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Downtown Service District Services Agreement. Council adopted an ordinance approving a service agreement between the City of Roanoke and Downtown Roanoke Incorporated for the Downtown Service District. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Adopted: Williamson Road Area Service District Agreement. Council approved an ordinance authorizing the Williamson Road Area Service District Agreement between the City of Roanoke and the Greater Williamson Road Area Business Association. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Adopted: Towing Advisory Board Membership Amendments. Council adopted an ordinance amending Section 2-321(a) of the City Code to alter the number of members and makeup of the Towing Advisory Board. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Adopted: Youth Services Citizen Board Composition Amendments. Council approved an ordinance amending City Code Chapter 17, Sections 17-31 and 17-32, altering member appointments and composition for the Youth Services Citizen Board. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6502,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Jun 1, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Briefing on Towing Advisory Board Code Amendment. Council scheduled or held an informal briefing on a proposed code amendment to Section 2-321 concerning the Towing Advisory Board under Chapter 2 (Administration).
Discussion / report: Briefing on Youth Services Citizen Board Code Amendments. Council received an informal briefing regarding proposed amendments to Sections 17-31 and 17-32 of Chapter 17 (Human Resources) regarding the Youth Services Citizen Board's creation, composition, terms, membership restrictions, and qualifications.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6491,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, May 18, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Architectural Review Board Application Process and Backlog Clearance. City staff reported on planning discussions to expand the Architectural Review Board's role in evaluating Certificate of Appropriateness applications during public meetings, and announced that an administrative review backlog of 22 overdue applications was cleared between April 27 and May 9, 2026.
Adopted: Fare Free Election Day Bus Service for 2026. City Council passed Resolution No. 43395-051826 approving and ratifying the Greater Roanoke Transit Company's implementation of fare-free bus service on election days in April, August, and November 2026. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Appointment of Trustees to the Roanoke City School Board. Council adopted Resolution No. 43396-051826 appointing two trustees to the Roanoke City School Board for terms running from July 1, 2026, to June 30, 2029. Recorded vote: 5-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6490,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, May 11, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Adoption of Employee Pay Plan and Stipends Effective July 1, 2026. City Council adopted Ordinance No. 43391-051126 approving a Pay Plan for officers, employees, Council-appointed officers, and Constitutional Officers; authorizing salary adjustments and merit increases; and approving monthly stipends for certain board and commission members, effective July 1, 2026. The measure passed 6-1, with Vice-Mayor McGuire voting no. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6475,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Tue, Sep 8, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: City Manager Briefings on Bonds, Performance Report, Department Assessment, and Monthly Budget. The City Manager's report scheduled briefings regarding the Davenport Plan of Finance for 2026 General Obligation Bonds, the 2026 Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report, a Planning, Building and Development Assessment, and the July Monthly Budget Report.
Adopted: VDSS Cost-of-Living Adjustment Funding Acceptance and Allocation. Council adopted an ordinance accepting and allocating a cost-of-living adjustment from the Virginia Department of Social Services. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: VDSS Funding for Family Services Specialists Pay Band Salary Increase. Council approved an ordinance accepting and allocating funding from the Virginia Department of Social Services for a pay band salary increase for Family Services Specialists. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: VDSS One-Time Bonus Funding Acceptance and Allocation. City Council passed an ordinance accepting and allocating a one-time bonus from the Virginia Department of Social Services. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: City Manager Comments on Leadership Retreat, Wasena Bridge, and Emergency Preparedness. The City Manager provided updates reporting on a department directors' leadership retreat held at RoVa Labs on September 2-3, progress on the Wasena Bridge Replacement project (approximately 95% complete with reopening expected in the coming weeks), and activities for National Preparedness Month involving Emergency Management and Stormwater teams.
Discussion / report: City Attorney Briefing on Youth Athletics Review Board Code Amendment. The City Attorney scheduled a 10-minute briefing on a code amendment to Section 2-316 concerning the Youth Athletics Review Board.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6556,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Aug 17, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: City Manager Briefings on Arts, Williamson Road, and Performance Dashboard. The City Manager presented briefings to City Council regarding the Annual Arts and Culture Briefing and FY 2027 Public Art Workplan, a Williamson Road update, and Performance Dashboard Metrics.
Discussion / report: City Manager Report on ACFR Presentation and Audit Findings. The City Manager updated Council on the Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR), explaining presentation delays caused by finance staffing turnover and a financial system implementation. The report noted audit findings and ongoing corrective actions before an upcoming presentation by external auditors in September.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6543,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Sep 21, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Presentation on Collective Bargaining by Roanoke Firefighters Association. The Roanoke Firefighters Association delivered a presentation to share information on collective bargaining, presented by President and Spokesperson Todd Reighley and sponsored by Council Members Sanchez-Jones and Nash. Council received and filed the presentation.
Adopted: Ordinance Amending Code Section Regarding Youth Athletics Review Board. City Council voted 6-1 to adopt an ordinance amending and reordaining Section 2-316 (Youth athletics review board) under Article XIV, Chapter 2 of the Code of the City of Roanoke. Vice-Mayor McGuire voted in opposition. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Adopted: Creation of Temporary Ad Hoc Professional Standards Committee. City Council passed Resolution No. 43475-092126 creating a temporary ad hoc Professional Standards Committee by a 6-1 vote, with Vice-Mayor McGuire voting against. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6565,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Aug 3, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Municipal North Lobby Security Door Installation. The City Manager announced the start of installation of new security doors in the Municipal North Lobby to enhance building safety, utilizing overnight work, employee badge access, and visitor escorts.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6534,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Oct 19, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Roanoke Cultural Endowment Update. Roanoke Cultural Endowment Executive Director Shaleen Powell presented an update to City Council, sponsored by Mayor Cobb and Council Member Volosin, which was received and filed.
Discussion / report: Arts and Culture Plan 2026 Briefing. The City Manager provided a 15-minute briefing to City Council regarding the Arts and Culture Plan 2026.
Adopted: National League of Cities City Summit Voting Delegate Designation. Council voted 7-0 to adopt Resolution No. 43484-101926, designating a Voting Delegate and Alternate Voting Delegate for the National League of Cities City Summit Annual Business Meeting. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Economic Development Authority Director Appointment. Council voted 7-0 to adopt Resolution No. 43485-101926, appointing a Director to the Economic Development Authority for the City of Roanoke. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: Proposed Committees for Railroad Transition and Onzlee Ware Plaza. Council Member Volosin suggested forming a Railroad Transition Committee regarding the Norfolk Southern and Union Pacific merger, as well as a committee for the state-funded Onzlee Ware Plaza at the courthouse. Mayor Cobb advised establishing an appointment process.
Discussion / report: Roanoke Neighborhood Advocates Annual Report. Representatives from Roanoke Neighborhood Advocates and the Neighborhood Services Coordinator presented the board's annual report and activities to City Council.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6588,plainText=false)
